scope: Study 05 final all-green run 20260921T-survey3 (digest 03fac739d0835768), its report, signed analysis, partially-superseded discussion, superseded analysis chain, reference cells, controls and registry entries.

verdicts.reason: Every ratio re-derived from results/20260921T-survey3/pg-single/*.json warm_reads: legacy 7794 -> 20233 (2.60x) / 18667 (2.39x); owned 5805 -> 20380 (3.51x); owned-pess 7043 -> 15782 (2.24x).
verdicts.required_scope: warm cacheable reads, one small PostgreSQL node, one trial, PostgreSQL + Redis cache only, db-only resource framing, closed loop; not uncacheable reads, writes, larger scales, or a cache paying for its own container

verdicts.reason: All controlled-pair read differences re-derived inside the run's ~20% noise floor (-8.3% to +12.3%); the cost is on the write path (more fences).
verdicts.required_scope: read throughput only, small scale, one trial; must not be restated as 'strict freshness is free'

verdicts.reason: Accurate: real 300s TTL/churn unmeasured, single small trial, no equal-total accounting, no YugabyteDB/cluster, placement pair never executed, closed-loop demand only. Coverage gaps, not null results.
verdicts.follow_up: Owned by task-20260922T025912Z-study05-v2-protocol. This review requires that protocol to add: (a) repeated trials and ideally a second machine for the three-instance result; (b) real-TTL churn across the 300s boundary; (c) equal-total framing charging the Redis container's budget; (d) execution of the placement pair with verified placement, or an explicit 'colocation untested' statement.

material_corrections.detail: Its wrong-read table swaps the legacy and owned three-instance rows. Correct mapping from the run JSON: legacy-na-redis-through-relaxed instances_3 = 35287 wrong / 40449 total = 87.24% (40442 cache hits); owned-opt-redis-through-relaxed instances_3 = 38749 wrong / 44126 total = 87.81% (44122 cache hits). The generated report already attributes 87.81% to o:opt:red:wth:rel. The signed analysis is not edited; the book must use the corrected mapping.
material_corrections.follow_up: Correct the derived claim/prose in the evidence correction; verify the '86% in a second run' figure against its own run before quoting.

scope_requirements: Redis is measured as a shared cache backend, never as an authoritative key-value store. No cell measures Redis durability, persistence, failover or eviction as a system of record; the book must not present these numbers as a Redis-vs-PostgreSQL database comparison.
The three-instance result is single-trial, one machine, small scale; it is a strong within-run separation (87% vs 0%) but its generality is unproven.
The superseded discussion's residual-failure sections are retired; only its fence/acknowledgement/pending-state mechanism sections may be cited.
notes: This is the first independent review of Study 05. No measurement was performed or authorized.
Existing signed artifacts were not edited; the review adds one signed analysis and cites the others.
